body:
PR #65 is ready for review with a completed target-repository export:

- [Immutable archive](https://github.com/nexicturbo/THE-ERROR-IS-THE-MESSAGE/tree/1f659cfcb1d581e967f7e7298afbb3dd0617ea68/archive) and [test 1: issue 60](https://github.com/nexicturbo/THE-ERROR-IS-THE-MESSAGE/tree/1f659cfcb1d581e967f7e7298afbb3dd0617ea68/archive/issues/60.md).
- 415 saved files, 1,974,836,504 bytes, zero errors; includes README uploads and all eight release ZIP/TAR packages.
- Every original file was restored and SHA-256 checked, then all assets were independently verified from the published commit's Git objects. 18 regression tests pass.

The remaining limitation is explicit in the PR: the manual Actions workflow is supplied as an installation template, because my credential has not received workflow permission. No hosted run is claimed. Could you review this candidate for the stated €100 bounty and confirm whether you require the hosted demonstration before acceptance? The code, complete archive, recovery utility and installation steps are available now.
